SilverBullet 2.11 brings massive updates to the open-source markdown note-taking app. 📝

This release introduces real-time collaboration with revisions, @mentions, and comments. It also adds robust multi-space and multi-user support backed by SSO and permissions. Finally, enjoy a UX refresh featuring dockable views and monospace fonts.

Release: https://github.com/silverbulletmd/silverbullet/releases/tag/2.11.0
Run it: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=silverbullet

#opensource #selfhosted
